references.shows: The side photo shows the broad bell and a deep body with long, nested slide returns below four top-action pistons.
Maker reference for the chosen instrument form and proportions.

silhouette: Wide upright bell above a deep asymmetric wrap with a heavy lower bow.
features: Wide bell rim and strongly expanding bell stack
Large bottom bow linking the bell and valve side
Four top-action pistons above the smaller slides
Leadpipe curving down from the opposite upper side
iconFeatures: Wide bell and heavy upright U-shaped wrap.
Long nested return inside the body.
avoid: Overlapping tubes that hide the principal bends
Detached or offset mouthpiece and bell
notes: The neutral catalogue photo of the YBB-321 guides the silhouette and visible tube routing. The illustration simplifies overlapping plumbing from the side.

geometry.view: Neutral catalogue side view in playing orientation
geometry.proportions: The bell is close to two fifths of the full height in width. A heavy bottom bow surrounds a deep wrap and long valve slides.
geometry.partLayout: Carry the right bell throat into the heavy bottom bow and left riser. Stack the narrower long returns inside the outer U. Route the leadpipe from the right into the four-piston valve group.

documentedDimensions.value: 443 mm bell diameter with an 18.5–19.5 mm bore. These are physical cross-sections, not widths in an oblique drawing.
